## Coaching Points

- Maintain a constant back angle during the initial lift-off (the shoulders, hips, knees, and bar should all move together as one unit)
- Do not jerk the bar off the floor; pull it smoothly and under control
- The bar should remain in contact with the legs throughout the entire lift

## 2. Barbell Romanian Deadlift (RDL)

Exercise Objective: Develop strength in the hamstrings, gluteals, and torso stabilizers
